# LatestLY

> > LatestLY is India's breaking news and current affairs platform covering national news, geopolitics, business, education, lifestyle, and viral social content.

LatestLY delivers real-time news coverage across India with focus on major cities including Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad. The platform extensively covers geopolitical developments affecting India, particularly the Middle East conflict and Strait of Hormuz crisis, alongside daily updates on commodity prices, weather forecasts, education results, and viral social media stories.

## Key Topics

- India national news
- Middle East conflict impact
- Strait of Hormuz crisis
- West Asia geopolitics
- Indian cities coverage (Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Hyderabad)
- Oil and energy security
- Commodity prices (petrol, silver)
- Weather forecasts and IMD updates
- UPSC and education results
- Viral videos and social media stories
- Political controversies
- Indian evacuations from Gulf
- Ramadan and Islamic festivals
- Stock market updates
- Fact-checking and misinformation
